brain.title: Choose a brain
brain.lede: {name} needs a brain to think. Pick one — you can change it any time.
brain.quick.title: Start in one click
brain.quick.text: Sign in with OpenRouter: a free account that gives access to hundreds of brains, some of them free.
brain.key.title: Use a key you already have
brain.key.text: Your key stays on this device, encrypted.
brain.key.label: Key
brain.local.title: On your computer
brain.local.text: Use a brain that runs on your own machine, with Ollama or LM Studio.
brain.local.hint: In Ollama, allow this site with OLLAMA_ORIGINS={origin}. In LM Studio, turn on CORS.
settings.title: Settings
settings.rulesText: Choose what {name} can do on its own, what it should ask you about first, and what it must never do.
settings.about: Open source. Runs entirely in your browser.
storage.persisted: Your browser will keep this data.
storage.persist: Keep my data on this device
storage.ephemeral: Private window: nothing will be saved after you close it.
update.ready: A new version of {name} is ready.
error.auth: {brain} refused the key. Check it, or connect another brain.
error.rate_limit: {brain} is busy or your limit is reached. Wait a moment and try again.
error.cors_or_offline: Couldn’t reach {brain}. You may be offline, or the service doesn’t accept requests from this site ({origin}).
error.bad_request: {brain} didn’t accept the request. Try another version of this brain.
error.not_found: {brain} couldn’t find this version. Pick another one.
error.server: {brain} is having trouble. Try again in a moment.
error.bad_response: {brain} sent an answer that couldn’t be read. Try again.
activity.cached: reused what it had already read
files.unsupported: Can’t read this kind of file yet
files.missing: {name} is no longer on this device
dictation.download: Dictation on this device needs a one-time download of about {size} MB. Download it now?
dictation.denied: Allow the microphone in your browser to dictate.
brain.device.title: On this device
brain.device.text: Private and free, and it works offline: nothing you write leaves this computer.
brain.device.alternative: Or start right now with a free account, below.
brain.device.progress: {done} of {total}. You can keep using this page.
brain.device.ready: The brain on this device is ready
backup.text: A backup is one file with all your conversations and files. Your keys are never in it.
backup.confirmRestore: Add everything from this backup? Nothing here will be deleted.
error.too_long: This conversation is too long for {brain}. Start a new one, or choose a bigger brain.
dictation.nothing: Nothing was heard. Try again, a little closer to the microphone.
dictation.retry: This browser’s own dictation didn’t answer. Press again to use dictation on this device instead.
suggest.title: Suggestions
suggest.email.prompt: Draft an email based on that.
auto.name: Auto
auto.text: Picks the right brain for each message
auto.smarter.prompt: Please look at this again, more thoroughly.
auto.reason.private: you chose never to use the cloud
auto.reason.personal: kept on this device: personal content
auto.reason.unhappy: a step up after the last answer
auto.noPrivate: There is no brain on this device to use without the cloud. Add one, or allow the cloud.
picker.title: Which brain?
offer.title: Something new
cap.files.name: Files
cap.files.text: Drop in PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV or text files, and {name} reads them.
cap.files.offer: You can drop files on me: PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV or text.
cap.made.name: Copy, spreadsheets, print
cap.made.text: Copy answers with their formatting, download tables for Excel, print or save as PDF.
cap.compute.name: Calculations
cap.compute.text: {name} works numbers out exactly by running small programs in a sandbox, with no internet access.
cap.compute.offer: Want exact numbers? {name} can calculate with your data instead of estimating, safely, on this device.
cap.reflexes.name: Intuition
cap.reflexes.text: A small helper on this device ({size}, once) that senses what you need: the right brain for each message, suggestions, new things to try. Nothing leaves this device.
cap.reflexes.offer: Let {name} get a feel for what you need? A small helper ({size}, once) picks the right brain and suggests next steps, without sending anything anywhere.
cap.reflexes.failed: Intuition couldn’t be downloaded. Try again later.
cap.backup.name: Backup
cap.backup.text: Keep a copy of everything in one file, and restore it on any device.
cap.backup.offer: Your conversations live only in this browser. Keep a copy of everything?
cap.brain-local.name: A brain on this device
cap.brain-local.text: Private, free and offline: a brain that runs on this computer, if it is powerful enough.
collection.title: What {name} can do
collection.lede: What {name} has discovered so far is lit. The rest shows up when it helps, or you can turn it on now.
